Macaque T–M RRR. Explicit D1/D2 HC–GC consensus cells (n = 180); 1,000 variable genes → 20 transcriptomic PCs; frozen 18-feature morphology response; rank = 3. Non-D1/D2 cells were excluded before model fitting. T panels show fitted transcriptomic shared scores and M panels show observed morphology scores.
